verifications.note: Original reproduced in this run on 26642c72: r1 R1a (an OPEN High mandatory finding relabelled to DG1 escapes) and R1b (a dropped finding) pass the gate (15-r1). Fixed on e11b5f08: carried test 16 rejects a relabel to DG1, a sidecar relabel, a drop, and deleting round 1. The round-4/6 variants (tests 3-7, which rewrite committed sidecars to drop findings) are all rejected by write-once (04-carried-neutral-on-e11b5f0). The candidate's own tests pass (05).

Not fully fixed. Original reproduced on 26642c72: r1 R0 passes DG0 with fabricated 5-field run records and no transcripts (15-r1). On e11b5f08 the narrower vectors are rejected: a 4-field meta without transcript/result, a mismatched transcript hash, and a verifying record without an assignment (carried tests 14-15, 04-carried-neutral-on-e11b5f0). However, the finding's expected behaviour (the transcript's init/prompt/result lines must be present and carry the session) is not enforced when the transcript is valid gzip of '' or of newlines. rules.mjs:294 wraps every transcript check in 'if (lines.length)', so a fabricated meta.json + result.json + empty transcript passes validateGate in current and historical mode (repro-r7 tests 3-7, 01-repro-r7-on-e11b5f0). This is the original forgery cost again. Raised as F-DG0-132; fixing F-DG0-132 closes this finding too.

Original reproduced on 26642c72: r1 R2 shows symlinks silently excluded and repointable after approval (15-r1). Fixed on e11b5f08: carried test 19 shows that a symlink repoint and a file/symlink swap change the committed candidate, and that gitlinks are refused (04-carried-neutral-on-e11b5f0). candidate.mjs:101 and :126 hash symlinks as 'symlink:<target>' with mode 120000.

Original reproduced on 26642c72: r1 R3 shows that an exclude added to the frozen manifest spec hides deliverables (15-r1). The real manifest dee0316d has that spec (11-validators-at-head).

Original reproduced on 26642c72: r1 R6 shows the guard following no symlinks and leaving settings.local.json, .mcp.json and trading_agent writable (15-r1). Fixed on e11b5f08, tested end to end through the real per-role hook commands (07-guard-e2e). For the implementer, all of the following are blocked with exit 2: .claude/settings.local.json, .mcp.json, sub/CLAUDE.md, trading_agent/x.py, tools/gates/**, write-scopes.json, stages.json, docs/source, reviews, the '..' segment, the upper-case path, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and a symlinked directory. src/ok.ts is allowed. A garbage payload is blocked. With git absent, the guard fails closed (08-guard-no-git). The Bash gap is disclosed in agent-protocol.md:78 and D-020 (13-static-checks, 14-doc-drift).

Fixed on e11b5f08: carried test 21 rejects '#', '.', a directory and a bare token as evidence, and rejects empty gate tests[] (04-carried-neutral-on-e11b5f0). repoFile (rules.mjs:49-64) requires a regular file whose real path is inside the repository.

Original shown statically on 26642c72: no --stage/--task/--role/--model validation, RUN_ID without a session suffix, and 'mkdir -p' reuses directories (17-runner-ci-originals). Fixed on e11b5f08 (run-agent.sh:35-38, 48, 51). Executed: '--stage DG9', '--stage DG0;id', '--task ../../x', '--task $(id)', '--role ../x' and '--model x;id' exit 64, and '--assignment /etc/passwd' exits 66. No run directory with ';' or '..' is created. Session IDs are unique across 10 runs. An assignment path containing $(...) and backticks is passed as data (no PWNED file), and the replayed prompt carries the literal path (09-runner-e2e, 16-runner-on-e11b5f08).

Original shown on 26642c72: actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 are mutable tags (17-runner-ci-originals). Fixed on e11b5f08: both actions are pinned to 40-hex commit SHAs with version comments. permissions is contents: read, fetch-depth is 0, and the workflow has no secrets, continue-on-error or '|| true' (13-static-checks). Every step is a plain command, so a failing validator exits non-zero and fails the job.

Carried test 2 (a genuine FAIL keeps the gate closed) passes (04-carried-neutral-on-e11b5f0). Note: the closure's run binding inherits the F-DG0-132 empty-transcript gap, which is tracked there.

All three drift items are fixed on e11b5f08 (14-doc-drift). (1) Verifications are now bound: checkClosure calls checkInvocation with assignment, notBefore, manifestPath and outputs (rules.mjs:567). (2) D-019, agents.md and run-agent.sh all say 6 resumes. The agent-protocol's 'up to 3 times' is the separate per-command retry rule. (3) agents.md:23 lists .claude/**, .mcp.json and CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md at any depth, matching write-scopes.json. New drift is covered by F-DG0-132: D-016 and D-022 describe the transcript checks as unconditional, which they are not for empty transcripts.

Originals reproduced in this run. On 540b3c69, r3 tests 4-6 edit committed sidecars and records to drop a High finding, flip a FAIL verification and flip a FAIL verdict (15-r3). On 53f5d176, r4 N1/N1b hide the edit in an evil merge (15-r4). On a059b55 (the round-6 residual), carried tests 10-11 (N4/N4b), a back-dated side branch plus merge, still pass the gate (04-carried-neutral-on-a059b55). On e11b5f08 all are rejected: carried tests 3-9 FIXED, and N4/N4b now fail. The errors are 'was committed with 2 different contents', 'has a M event' and 'is back-dated before its parent' (04-carried-neutral-on-e11b5f0; message-wording-only differences explained in 03-carried-on-e11b5f0). Real repository history passes the new checks (12-real-history-writeonce: checkWriteOnce []). I found no way around the single-blob rule. Colour config does not affect --raw, and log.showRoot=false only hides root-commit adds. The runner commits a review's outputs immediately (16-runner-on-e11b5f08). Scope note: the defence-in-depth transcript replay advertised with this fix is skipped for empty transcripts. That only matters for fabricated or uncommitted run directories, which are F-DG0-102/F-DG0-132 territory and tracked there, not the in-place-edit problem this finding describes.
